import functools
import types

import numpy
import riichienv

from model import outcomes

from . import _native_collection, shanten

# Bonus counts are exact until ordinary hand value saturates at kazoe.
BONUS_HAN = tuple(range(14))
CELLS = tuple(map(tuple, numpy.argwhere(outcomes.PAYMENT_CELLS)))

NAMES = (
    "pinfu",
    "tanyao",
    "iipeikou",
    "haku",
    "hatsu",
    "chun",
    "seat_wind",
    "round_wind",
    "sanshoku_doujun",
    "ittsuu",
    "chanta",
    "honroutou",
    "toitoi",
    "sanankou",
    "sankantsu",
    "sanshoku_doukou",
    "chiitoitsu",
    "shousangen",
    "honitsu",
    "junchan",
    "ryanpeikou",
    "chinitsu",
    "yakuman",
)
YAKU_IDS = {
    "pinfu": 14,
    "tanyao": 12,
    "iipeikou": 13,
    "haku": 7,
    "hatsu": 8,
    "chun": 9,
    "seat_wind": 10,
    "round_wind": 11,
    "sanshoku_doujun": 17,
    "ittsuu": 16,
    "chanta": 15,
    "honroutou": 24,
    "toitoi": 21,
    "sanankou": 22,
    "sankantsu": 20,
    "sanshoku_doukou": 19,
    "chiitoitsu": 25,
    "shousangen": 23,
    "honitsu": 27,
    "junchan": 26,
    "ryanpeikou": 28,
    "chinitsu": 29,
}

YAKU_BITS = {value: 1 << NAMES.index(name) for name, value in YAKU_IDS.items()}


def completion_flags(
    tiles, melds, player_wind, round_wind, require_all=True, family_routes=False
):
    counts = numpy.bincount(numpy.asarray(tiles) // 4, minlength=34)
    distance = shanten.calculate_shanten(counts)
    if distance not in (0, 1):
        return numpy.full(len(NAMES), -1, numpy.int8)
    if distance == 0:
        waits = riichienv.HandEvaluator(tiles, melds).get_waits()
        if not waits:
            return numpy.full(len(NAMES), -1, numpy.int8)
        flags = (1 << len(NAMES)) - 1 if require_all else 0
        for tile in waits:
            physical = tile * 4 + (1 if tile in (4, 13, 22) else 0)
            for tsumo in (False, True):
                score = _native_collection.score_hand(
                    types.SimpleNamespace(
                        tiles=list(tiles) + [physical],
                        melds=melds,
                        agari_tile=physical,
                        dora_indicators=[],
                    ),
                    riichienv.Conditions(
                        tsumo=tsumo,
                        player_wind=(
                            riichienv.Wind.East,
                            riichienv.Wind.South,
                            riichienv.Wind.West,
                            riichienv.Wind.North,
                        )[player_wind],
                        round_wind=round_wind,
                    ),
                    [],
                )
                candidate = int(bool(score.yakuman)) << NAMES.index("yakuman")
                for yaku in score.yaku:
                    candidate |= YAKU_BITS.get(yaku, 0)
                if family_routes:
                    for name, distance in zip(
                        ("tanyao", "honitsu", "chanta"),
                        shanten.calculate_yaku_shanten(
                            counts + (numpy.arange(34) == tile),
                            [[t // 4 for t in meld.tiles] for meld in melds],
                        ),
                    ):
                        candidate &= ~(1 << NAMES.index(name))
                        candidate |= int(distance == -1) << NAMES.index(name)
                flags = flags & candidate if require_all else flags | candidate
                if require_all and not flags:
                    return numpy.zeros(len(NAMES), numpy.int8)
        return numpy.array(
            [(flags >> index) & 1 for index in range(len(NAMES))], numpy.int8
        )
    first_draws = shanten.improving(counts)[1]
    if not first_draws:
        return numpy.full(len(NAMES), -1, numpy.int8)
    result = numpy.full(len(NAMES), int(require_all), numpy.int8)
    for draw in first_draws:
        added = draw * 4 + (1 if draw in (4, 13, 22) else 0)
        hand = list(tiles) + [added]
        next_counts = counts + (numpy.arange(34) == draw)
        flags = numpy.zeros(len(NAMES), numpy.int8)
        for cut in numpy.flatnonzero(next_counts):
            if (
                shanten.calculate_shanten(
                    next_counts - (numpy.arange(34) == cut)
                )
                != 0
            ):
                continue
            retained = list(hand)
            retained.remove(next(tile for tile in retained if tile // 4 == cut))
            candidate = completion_flags(
                tiles=retained,
                melds=melds,
                player_wind=player_wind,
                round_wind=round_wind,
                require_all=require_all,
                family_routes=family_routes,
            )
            flags |= numpy.maximum(candidate, 0)
        result = result & flags if require_all else result | flags
    return result


@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=65536)
def path_completion_flags(counts, melds, player_wind, round_wind):
    """Share immutable scoring evidence across overlapping shortest paths."""
    return tuple(
        completion_flags(
            tiles=[
                tile * 4 + copy
                for tile, count in enumerate(counts)
                for copy in range(count)
            ],
            melds=[
                riichienv.Meld(
                    (
                        riichienv.MeldType.Chi,
                        riichienv.MeldType.Pon,
                        riichienv.MeldType.Daiminkan,
                        riichienv.MeldType.Ankan,
                        riichienv.MeldType.Kakan,
                    )[kind],
                    list(hand),
                    opened,
                )
                for kind, hand, opened in melds
            ],
            player_wind=player_wind,
            round_wind=round_wind,
            family_routes=True,
        )
        > 0
    )


def hand_yaku_fractions(
    counts, unavailable, melds, player_wind, round_wind, cuts=None, names=NAMES
):
    """Copy-weighted shortest routes; truncated searches are unknown."""
    paths = shanten.tenpai_paths(counts, unavailable, cuts)
    if paths is None:
        return numpy.full(len(names), -1.0)
    if set(names) <= {"tanyao", "honitsu", "chanta"}:
        # Necessary shape conditions only: rejected routes cannot carry any
        # requested family, regardless of winning tile or decomposition.
        # Honitsu/chanta include their full-flush/pure-outside counterparts.
        whole = paths[0] + numpy.bincount(
            [tile // 4 for meld in melds for tile in meld.tiles], minlength=34
        )
        possible = {
            "tanyao": ~whole[:, [0, 8, 9, 17, 18, 26, *range(27, 34)]].any(
                axis=1
            ),
            "honitsu": (
                whole[:, :27].reshape(-1, 3, 9).any(axis=2).sum(axis=1) <= 1
            ),
            "chanta": ~whole[:, [3, 4, 5, 12, 13, 14, 21, 22, 23]].any(axis=1),
        }
        possible = numpy.any([possible[name] for name in names], axis=0)
    else:
        possible = numpy.ones(len(paths[0]), numpy.bool_)
    melds = tuple(
        (int(meld.meld_type), tuple(meld.tiles), meld.opened) for meld in melds
    )
    supported = numpy.array(
        [
            (
                path_completion_flags(
                    counts=hand.tobytes(),
                    melds=melds,
                    player_wind=player_wind,
                    round_wind=round_wind,
                )
                if viable
                else (False,) * len(NAMES)
            )
            for hand, viable in zip(paths[0], possible)
        ],
        numpy.bool_,
    )
    return (paths[1] @ supported[:, [NAMES.index(name) for name in names]]) / (
        paths[1].sum()
    )


def score_waits(tiles, melds, context):
    evaluator = riichienv.HandEvaluator(list(tiles), list(melds))
    waits = evaluator.get_waits()
    furiten = context["missed_agari"] or bool(
        set(context["own_discards"]) & set(waits)
    )
    rows = []
    closed = all(not meld.opened for meld in melds)
    for base in waits:
        for red in (False, True) if base in (4, 13, 22) else (False,):
            suit = base // 9
            unseen = (
                1 - context["unavailable_red"][suit]
                if red
                else 4
                - context["unavailable_counts"][base]
                - (
                    1 - context["unavailable_red"][suit]
                    if base in (4, 13, 22)
                    else 0
                )
            )
            tile = base * 4 + (0 if red or base not in (4, 13, 22) else 1)
            while tile in tiles and tile < base * 4 + 3:
                tile += 1
            values = []
            for riichi, tsumo in (
                (False, False),
                (False, True),
                (True, False),
                (True, True),
            ):
                score = _native_collection.score_hand(
                    types.SimpleNamespace(
                        tiles=list(tiles) + [tile],
                        melds=melds,
                        agari_tile=tile,
                        dora_indicators=context["dora_indicators"],
                    ),
                    riichienv.Conditions(
                        riichi=riichi,
                        tsumo=tsumo,
                        player_wind=(
                            riichienv.Wind.East,
                            riichienv.Wind.South,
                            riichienv.Wind.West,
                            riichienv.Wind.North,
                        )[context["player_wind"]],
                        round_wind=context["round_wind"],
                    ),
                    [],
                )
                legal = (
                    score.is_win
                    and (not riichi or closed)
                    and (tsumo or not furiten)
                )
                points = (
                    score.tsumo_agari_ko
                    * (3 if context["player_wind"] == 0 else 2)
                    + (
                        0
                        if context["player_wind"] == 0
                        else score.tsumo_agari_oya
                    )
                    if tsumo
                    else score.ron_agari
                )
                yaku_ids = set(score.yaku)
                values.append(
                    {
                        "points": int(points) if legal else 0,
                        "han": score.han if legal else 0,
                        "fu": score.fu if legal else 0,
                        "legal": bool(legal),
                        "yakuman": bool(score.yakuman),
                        "yaku": [
                            int(
                                bool(score.yakuman)
                                if name == "yakuman"
                                else YAKU_IDS[name] in yaku_ids
                            )
                            for name in NAMES
                        ],
                    }
                )
            rows.append(
                {
                    "tile": 34 + suit if red else base,
                    "unseen": int(max(0, unseen)),
                    "values": values,
                }
            )
    summary = numpy.zeros((4, 8), numpy.float32)
    for scenario in range(4):
        legal = [
            row
            for row in rows
            if row["unseen"] > 0 and row["values"][scenario]["legal"]
        ]
        if legal:
            weights = numpy.array([row["unseen"] for row in legal])
            points = [row["values"][scenario]["points"] for row in legal]
            summary[scenario, :4] = [
                len({shanten.base_id(row["tile"]) for row in legal}),
                weights.sum(),
                min(points),
                max(points),
            ]
            for column, key in ((4, "points"), (5, "han"), (6, "fu")):
                summary[scenario, column] = numpy.average(
                    [row["values"][scenario][key] for row in legal],
                    weights=weights,
                )
        summary[scenario, 7] = int(furiten and scenario % 2 == 0)
    return summary, rows


def win_contexts(events):
    """Use the training replay's physical tiles, including concealed kans."""
    from log_dataset import replay

    state = replay.Replay("payment-bonus", [])
    for event in events:
        if event["type"] in ("start_game", "end_game"):
            continue
        if event["type"] in {"ankan", "kakan"}:
            # A robbed kan never completes and does not cancel ippatsu.
            kan_ippatsu = tuple(state.ippatsu)
        if event["type"] == "hora":
            actor = event["actor"]
            tsumo = actor == event["target"]
            last = next(
                row
                for row in reversed(state.history)
                if row["type"] in ("tsumo", "dahai", "kakan", "ankan")
            )
            tile = shanten.base_id(last["pai"]) * 4
            tile += int(
                tile in (16, 52, 88) and not shanten.is_red(last["pai"])
            )
            observation = state.legal_observation(actor)
            hand = observation.hand if tsumo else [*observation.hand, tile]
            chankan = not tsumo and last["type"] in {"kakan", "ankan"}
            ctx = types.SimpleNamespace(
                tiles=hand,
                melds=state.melds[actor],
                seat=actor,
                agari_tile=tile,
                dora_indicators=observation.dora_indicators,
                ura_indicators=[
                    shanten.base_id(marker) * 4
                    for marker in event["ura_markers"]
                ],
                conditions=riichienv.Conditions(
                    tsumo=tsumo,
                    riichi=state.accepted[actor],
                    double_riichi=(
                        state.accepted[actor]
                        and state.rivers[actor][0]["riichi"]
                        and not any(
                            row["type"]
                            in replay.CALL_TYPES | {"ankan", "kakan"}
                            for row in state.history[
                                : state.rivers[actor][0]["event_index"]
                            ]
                        )
                    ),
                    ippatsu=(
                        kan_ippatsu[actor] if chankan else state.ippatsu[actor]
                    ),
                    haitei=tsumo
                    and state.live_wall == 0
                    and state.rinshan_actor != actor,
                    houtei=not tsumo and state.live_wall == 0,
                    rinshan=tsumo and state.rinshan_actor == actor,
                    chankan=chankan,
                    tsumo_first_turn=tsumo
                    and not state.rivers[actor]
                    and not any(state.melds),
                    player_wind=(
                        riichienv.Wind.East,
                        riichienv.Wind.South,
                        riichienv.Wind.West,
                        riichienv.Wind.North,
                    )[(actor - state.start["oya"]) % 4],
                    round_wind="ESWN".index(state.start["bakaze"]),
                ),
            )
            if state.accepted[actor]:
                assert len(ctx.ura_indicators) == len(ctx.dora_indicators), (
                    state.kyoku_id,
                    actor,
                    "Missing hidden bonus indicators",
                )
            ctx.actual = _native_collection.score_hand(
                ctx, ctx.conditions, ctx.ura_indicators
            )
            if not ctx.actual.is_win:
                raise ValueError((state.kyoku_id, event, "Unscorable win"))
            yield state.kyoku_id, ctx
        state.apply(event)


def bonus_han_scores(ctx):
    """One base hand, rescored by total situational/hidden bonus han.

    Riichi (including double riichi), ippatsu, last tile, rinshan, chankan
    and ura contribute only their combined han. Public dora/red and menzen
    tsumo stay in the base hand. The last bucket is 13+, already kazoe.
    True yakuman retain their actual multiplicity, independently of bonuses.
    """
    base = _native_collection.score_hand(
        ctx,
        riichienv.Conditions(
            tsumo=ctx.conditions.tsumo,
            tsumo_first_turn=ctx.conditions.tsumo_first_turn,
            player_wind=ctx.conditions.player_wind,
            round_wind=ctx.conditions.round_wind,
        ),
        [],
    )
    observed = 0 if base.yakuman else min(ctx.actual.han - base.han, 13)
    result = numpy.full((len(BONUS_HAN), 3), -1, numpy.int32)
    details = numpy.full((len(BONUS_HAN), 3), -1, numpy.int32)
    for bonus in (
        BONUS_HAN[:2] if any(meld.opened for meld in ctx.melds) else BONUS_HAN
    ):
        if not base.is_win and bonus == 0:
            continue
        han = base.han if base.yakuman else base.han + bonus
        points = (
            8000 * (han // 13)
            if base.yakuman
            else outcomes.basic_points(han, base.fu)
        )
        dealer = ctx.conditions.player_wind == riichienv.Wind.East
        result[bonus] = [
            (
                0
                if ctx.conditions.tsumo
                else 100 * ((points * (6 if dealer else 4) + 99) // 100)
            ),
            (
                100 * ((points * (2 if dealer else 1) + 99) // 100)
                if ctx.conditions.tsumo
                else 0
            ),
            (
                100 * ((points * 2 + 99) // 100)
                if ctx.conditions.tsumo and not dealer
                else 0
            ),
        ]
        details[bonus] = (han, base.fu, int(base.yakuman))
    numpy.testing.assert_array_equal(
        result[observed],
        [
            ctx.actual.ron_agari,
            ctx.actual.tsumo_agari_ko,
            ctx.actual.tsumo_agari_oya,
        ],
    )
    return result, observed, details


def round_labels(events):
    """Absolute-seat labels, checked against the canonical payment tensor."""
    from model import payment_scoring

    rounds = {}
    for event in events:
        if event["type"] == "start_kyoku":
            key = f"{event['bakaze']}{event['kyoku']}-{event['honba']}"
            rounds[key] = []
        if event["type"] not in ("start_game", "end_game"):
            rounds[key].append(event)
    result = {
        key: {
            "bonus": numpy.full((2, 4, 4), -1, numpy.int16),
            "score": numpy.full((2, 4, 4, len(BONUS_HAN)), -1, numpy.int16),
            "payment": outcomes.terminal_payments(rows),
        }
        for key, rows in rounds.items()
    }
    for key, ctx in win_contexts(events):
        amounts, observed, details = bonus_han_scores(ctx)
        kind = int(ctx.conditions.tsumo)
        payments = result[key]["payment"][kind, :, ctx.seat]
        dealer = ctx.conditions.player_wind == riichienv.Wind.East
        total = (
            amounts[:, 1] * (3 if dealer else 2)
            + (0 if dealer else amounts[:, 2])
            if kind
            else amounts[:, 0]
        )
        assert total[observed] == payments.sum(), (
            key,
            ctx.seat,
            total[observed],
            payments.tolist(),
        )
        for payer in numpy.flatnonzero(payments):
            if kind:
                dealer_seat = (
                    ctx.seat
                    - (
                        riichienv.Wind.East,
                        riichienv.Wind.South,
                        riichienv.Wind.West,
                        riichienv.Wind.North,
                    ).index(ctx.conditions.player_wind)
                ) % 4
                shares = amounts[:, 2 if payer == dealer_seat else 1]
            else:
                shares = amounts[:, 0]
            # Pao changes which seat pays the same scored total. The observed
            # allocation is label-only; ordinary transfers use scorer shares.
            if shares[observed] != payments[payer]:
                # Replayed native state can omit the pao flag. The recorded
                # allocation and independently scored yakuman total establish
                # this label; ordinary hands must match their scorer shares.
                if not ctx.actual.yakuman:
                    raise ValueError((key, "Unexpected payment allocation"))
                shares = (
                    total.astype(numpy.int64)
                    * payments[payer]
                    // total[observed]
                )
            valid = numpy.all(amounts >= 0, axis=1)
            result[key]["score"][kind, payer, ctx.seat, valid] = [
                payment_scoring.score_class(int(han), int(fu), bool(yakuman))
                for han, fu, yakuman in details[valid]
            ]
            result[key]["bonus"][kind, payer, ctx.seat] = (
                -1 if ctx.actual.yakuman else observed
            )
            assert shares[observed] == payments[payer]
    return result

"""Structural Mahjong distances and available improving continuations."""

import ctypes
import fcntl
import functools
import os
import pathlib
import subprocess

import numpy

BASE_IDS = numpy.array(list(range(34)) + [4, 13, 22, 0])
NYANTEN = pathlib.Path(__file__).parent / "nyanten"
LIBRARY = NYANTEN / ".native" / "analysis.so"


@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def native():
    LIBRARY.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    sources = sorted(NYANTEN.glob("*.cpp"))
    with (LIBRARY.parent / "build.lock").open("w") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        if not LIBRARY.exists() or LIBRARY.stat().st_mtime_ns < max(
            path.stat().st_mtime_ns
            for path in (
                pathlib.Path(__file__),
                *sources,
                *NYANTEN.rglob("*.hpp"),
            )
        ):
            subprocess.run(
                [
                    "c++",
                    "-O3",
                    "-DNDEBUG",
                    "-std=c++17",
                    "-shared",
                    "-fPIC",
                    "-I" + str(NYANTEN / "vendor"),
                    *map(str, sources),
                    "-o",
                    str(LIBRARY.with_suffix(".tmp")),
                ],
                check=True,
            )
            os.replace(LIBRARY.with_suffix(".tmp"), LIBRARY)
    dll = ctypes.CDLL(str(LIBRARY))
    dll.nyanten_shanten.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p]
    dll.nyanten_shanten.restype = ctypes.c_uint8
    dll.nyanten_preserves_completion.argtypes = [
        ctypes.c_void_p,
        ctypes.c_size_t,
        ctypes.c_char_p,
        ctypes.c_uint,
        ctypes.c_uint64,
    ]
    dll.nyanten_preserves_completion.restype = ctypes.c_bool
    dll.nyanten_families.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p]
    dll.nyanten_families.restype = ctypes.c_uint32
    dll.nyanten_yaku_shanten.argtypes = [
        ctypes.c_char_p,
        ctypes.c_char_p,
        ctypes.c_uint,
    ]
    dll.nyanten_yaku_shanten.restype = ctypes.c_uint32
    dll.nyanten_draw.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_uint]
    dll.nyanten_draw.restype = ctypes.c_uint64
    dll.nyanten_tenpai_paths.argtypes = [
        ctypes.c_char_p,
        ctypes.c_char_p,
        ctypes.c_uint64,
        ctypes.c_uint,
        ctypes.c_uint,
        ctypes.c_void_p,
        ctypes.c_void_p,
        ctypes.c_uint,
        ctypes.c_void_p,
    ]
    dll.nyanten_tenpai_paths.restype = ctypes.c_bool
    return dll


def calculate_families(counts):
    values = native().nyanten_families(bytes(map(int, counts)))
    return tuple(((values >> shift) & 255) - 1 for shift in (0, 8, 16))


def calculate_shanten(counts, all_forms=True):
    if all_forms:
        return native().nyanten_shanten(bytes(map(int, counts))) - 1
    return calculate_families(counts)[0]


def calculate_yaku_shanten(counts, melds=()):
    """Exact tanyao, flush and outside distances; 14 is impossible.

    Counts exclude fixed melds. Each meld contains three or four base tile IDs.
    Distances are missing draws minus one, with physical copy limits but no
    public-availability constraint. Flush includes honitsu and chinitsu.
    Outside includes chanta, junchan, honroutou and chinroutou: every group
    and pair contains a terminal or honor. Closed seven pairs is included.
    """
    values = native().nyanten_yaku_shanten(
        bytes(map(int, counts)),
        bytes(
            int(tile)
            for meld in melds
            for tile in (*meld, *([34] * (4 - len(meld))))
        ),
        len(melds),
    )
    return tuple(((values >> shift) & 255) - 1 for shift in (0, 8, 16))


def improving(counts, unavailable=None, all_forms=True):
    value = native().nyanten_draw(bytes(map(int, counts)), int(all_forms))
    tiles = [tile for tile in range(34) if value & (1 << tile)]
    unseen = 4 - numpy.asarray(counts if unavailable is None else unavailable)
    return (value >> 34) - 1, tiles, int(unseen[tiles].sum())


TILE_NAMES = tuple(
    [f"{rank}{suit}" for suit in "mps" for rank in range(1, 10)]
    + ["E", "S", "W", "N", "P", "F", "C"]
    + ["5mr", "5pr", "5sr"]
)
TILE_CODES = {tile: code for code, tile in enumerate(TILE_NAMES)}


def mjai_tile_code(tile):
    return TILE_CODES[tile]


def base_id(tile):
    return int(
        BASE_IDS[mjai_tile_code(tile) if isinstance(tile, str) else tile]
    )


def is_red(tile):
    return (mjai_tile_code(tile) if isinstance(tile, str) else tile) >= 34


def tenpai_paths(counts, unavailable, tile_ids=None):
    """Copy-weighted shortest routes, or None if the search is incomplete."""
    hands = numpy.empty((4096, 34), numpy.uint8)
    weights = numpy.empty(4096, numpy.uint64)
    size = ctypes.c_uint()
    complete = native().nyanten_tenpai_paths(
        bytes(map(int, counts)),
        bytes(map(int, unavailable)),
        (
            1 << 34
            if int(numpy.sum(counts)) % 3 == 1
            else sum(
                1 << int(cut)
                for cut in (
                    numpy.flatnonzero(counts)
                    if tile_ids is None
                    else numpy.unique(BASE_IDS[numpy.asarray(tile_ids, int)])
                )
            )
        ),
        3,
        512,
        hands.ctypes.data,
        weights.ctypes.data,
        len(hands),
        ctypes.byref(size),
    )
    return (hands[: size.value], weights[: size.value]) if complete else None

# Model architecture

The current source implements a shared public-state encoder, a factorized
legal-action policy, opponent belief marginals and an action-conditioned
current-hand payment distribution. Four residual board blocks connect the
encoder to the policy, beliefs and critic. [network.py](network.py) assembles
the graph; the [interactive catalog](catalog/README.md) indexes its blocks,
operators, equations and phase-specific gradient paths.

This document describes the source contract. Released checkpoints retain the
architecture and input/output signatures of their bundled source.

For commands, see [training and evaluation](../training/README.md). The
[native interface](../log_dataset/native_collection/README.md) defines tensor
encodings and packed transport.

The network input contract contains 125 native tensors. Candidate-hand indices
serve gathers only; they do not enter learned board projections. Dora indicator
IDs and their mask are absent; `dora_multiplicity` supplies tile-value evidence.
The board projection kernel is `[9055, 512]`. Removing dora fields also narrows
the hand bank's board-conditioning projection. Earlier checkpoints require
explicit weight transfer and compatible exports. Removing learned input rows
is not an output-preserving conversion. No runtime schema adapter is provided.

## Tensor signatures

Both SavedModel signatures accept the same 125 named input tensors. The
`policy` signature returns the five policy heads; `serving_default` returns
17 tensors. Shapes below omit the leading row axis. Most rows are public
positions; the last two outputs instead have one row per active candidate.
`critic_action_indices` maps each candidate row to `(position, action)`.

| Output | Shape |
| --- | --- |
| `discard_policy_logits` | `[37]` |
| `riichi_policy_logits` | `[74]` |
| `response_policy_logits` | `[150]` |
| `kan_action_logits` | `[35]` |
| `win_decision_logits` | `[2]` |
| `opponent_shanten_logits` | `[3, 4]` |
| `riichi_action_logits`, `response_action_logits`, `chi_pattern_logits` | `[2]`, `[4]`, `[3]` |
| `terminal_payment_probabilities` | `[4, 4, 4, 60]` |
| `payment_values` | `[60]` |
| `final_placement_probabilities` | `[4]` |
| `review_outcome_probabilities` | `[7]` |
| `settlement_mean`, `settlement_variance` | `[5]` each |
| `critic_expected_points` | `[4]` per active candidate |
| `critic_action_indices` | `[2]` per active candidate |

Count, ukeire and completion predictions remain internal network features and
restoration targets. [actions.py](actions.py), [export.py](export.py) and
[inference.py](inference.py) define the exact output and loading contracts.
Frozen exports keep their original signatures; regenerate an export before
loading it with the current strict inference API. Output pruning changes
neither learned weights nor continuation values.

## From a game state to an action

1. The native engine reconstructs public state and legal actions from events.
2. Feature extraction builds the current hand and legal post-action hands,
   including call/discard combinations. Opponents' concealed tiles are excluded.
3. The shared encoder produces board, river and candidate representations.
4. Belief and completion predictions feed the final policy. Legal masks remove
   unavailable choices before selection.

The policy has discard, riichi/discard, response, kan and win/pass heads. A response
includes its follow-up discard. Physical copies of the same tile share an
ordinary discard action; red fives remain distinct. Optional ron and tsumo
are learned choices; nine-terminals aborts remain automatic. Restoration
supervises win/pass from recorded choices. MMD currently shares one forecast
between accepting and declining, so Q supplies no accept/decline gradient.

[actor.py](actor.py) applies opening symmetry and final-wall safety rules.
Its other heuristic prior outputs support supervised restoration.
The [MMD objective](../training/OBJECTIVE.md#magnetic-mirror-descent) uses
detached action values and two policy anchors without positive-action priors.
Supervised restoration helpers remain separate from the improvement loop.

The final candidate scorer combines candidate representations, route affinity,
ron predictions and completion context. It has no learned `sakigiri_order`
scalar. Removing that branch also changes the scorer's input width: checkpoints
with the former branch are incompatible with strict current-model loading.
No live checkpoint conversion or runtime fallback is provided. Frozen exports
retain their original graph. Sakigiri witnesses remain a root-mining criterion,
independent of the network architecture.

## What the predictions mean

| Prediction | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Opponent beliefs | Shanten, structural waits and held tile-count marginals, including known melds. Concealed counts respect hand sizes and available copies; riichi and four fixed melds fix shanten to tenpai. |
| Completion yaku and score | The highest-scoring legal completion of the next observed tenpai shape, separately for ron and tsumo. Unknown targets are masked. |
| Route affinity | How much of a candidate's visible shortest-route support belongs to tanyao, flush or outside-hand families. |
| Hand settlement | A probability distribution over ways the hand can end and the resulting transfers. |
| Final placement | Settlement outcomes integrated through a fixed continuation model for the rest of the match. |

Structural waits can be blocked by furiten or lack of yaku. Completion potential
and route affinity are distinct from win probability.
The candidate value-range inputs are also conditional completion bounds: they
search available finishes from zero/one-shanten hands, without predicting how
likely those finishes are. Dama uses undeclared scoring; declaration and
already-accepted riichi use riichi scoring. The action-specific ron-valid
flag is false for no-yaku dama. See the [native input contract](../log_dataset/native_collection/README.md#action-conditioned-win-values)
for dataset regeneration requirements. Fixed-reference scoring tensors are
absent from the current input contract.

Call forecasts condition on attempting the call, including preemption by
competing claims. Accepted-call features describe the hypothetical candidate;
hard scoring constraints use guaranteed pre-call facts. The planned discard
is contingent, so its outcomes belong to the joint hand forecast rather than
a guaranteed immediate transition. Training retains preempted attempts.
Response passes also await priority resolution: neither last-wall exhaustion
nor acceptance of a pending riichi declaration is assumed at that boundary.

## Scoring and match value

The critic predicts events and hand values. Rule-based settlement converts
those into payments, handling dealer shares, honba, deposits and pot priority.
Tsumo shares use one common hand value. Multiple ron claims are represented
jointly; triple ron follows the simulator's abort rule.

The critic applies shared player and claim projections rather than separate
weights for each opponent/payment slot. Player descriptors combine public
evidence with mean/max summaries of the shared river convolutions. Wind
descriptors expose dealer/double-wind status,
known unavailable wind copies and dora multiplicity rather than wind identity.
Scores and placement priority remain explicit public inputs. The actor token
contains a self indicator because its hand and candidate action are known.
All four seats use the same player projection weights. Dealer status overlaps
with self/opponent identity: any of the four seats can be dealer; there is no
separate dealer or self-only projection.
Public meld tile counts and red counts retain observed meld identities. These
are pre-action facts; the common candidate context supplies our proposed hand.
Per-action descriptors add projected ordinary draws, eligibility by turn to
chi the active discard, and the discard source. Draw projections share the
actor's pass/call/kan continuation calculation and exclude rinshan. Chi turn
eligibility is not a claim that the hidden hand can make the call.

Every player receives the same common candidate context. Existing belief and
completion predictions stay in that common context; separate learned opponent
predictions are not added to the player-specific descriptors. Equal descriptors
and outcome roles therefore produce equal scores at fixed common context.
The common encoder depends on seat ordering, so the full network is not
invariant under arbitrary raw-input player permutations.

Shared role pooling scores whole win and draw masks, retaining all 49 event
choices and 16 conditional deposit masks. Nonlinear event and deposit scoring
retain interactions rather than multiplying independent player probabilities.
Simultaneous winners' hand-value likelihoods remain factorized conditional on
the shared context. Parameter sharing does not remove that approximation.

Changing these heads requires an explicit fitted checkpoint migration. The
actor, belief heads, common critic projection and shared hand-value decoder
can retain their weights; slot-specific event, deposit and claim projections
cannot be copied into the new shared layers with exact prediction parity.

[payment_scoring.py](payment_scoring.py) defines the score vocabulary and
legality masks. [joint_settlement.py](joint_settlement.py) combines events,
scores and deposits. Unsupported payments, including some responsibility and
nagashi allocations, are excluded from settlement likelihood and counted in
coverage metrics.

Training values actions by `ST3/100 + P(first) - P(fourth)`. Raw Saint 3 (ST3)
match points remain a separate evaluation and diagnostic output. Completed
matches use exact final scores and ranks. Earlier hands use a fixed continuation
model based on scores, remaining hands and scheduled dealerships. Its parameters
are separate from the learned current-hand critic.

The frozen four-parameter single-Gumbel continuation was recalibrated on
November 17 using 100,000 completed games: seven duplicate training matches
and three standard South Mortal matches. Its variance is a positive
`a + c*T + d*T²` curve in scheduled hands remaining, with positive dealership
drift. This is a pooled-match calibration, with no opponent-strength or
rules-format input. The additional data do not establish a held-out improvement
over the preceding 80,000-game calibration. Analytic mixtures remain experiments.

Actor and root scoring compute settlement payoffs once per public position
and reuse them across candidate actions. Only the settlement probabilities depend on the
action. Payoff construction and action forecasts use bounded GPU chunks; the
shared payoff tensor exists only for the current batch.

## Shared river encoding

Opponent rivers use shared tile embeddings and three masked convolutional
blocks, separately for pre- and post-riichi streams. Each stream contributes
its ordered token features and maximum to the board projection. Shared mean
and maximum summaries also feed the critic's per-player context. Padding is
masked after every convolution; empty streams remain zero.

Candidate representations combine the hand and board encodings directly.
There is no river self-attention or candidate-to-river attention. Tile
attention in opponent beliefs and the shared player/event critic remain.

## Tile interactions in opponent beliefs

Initial count and structural-wait predictions feed 34 tile tokens per opponent.
Each token includes tile identity, ordinary/red count probabilities, conditional
ukeire probabilities, public availability and meld counts, shanten probabilities
and board context. Two attention blocks share weights across opponents. Each
block uses four attention heads at width 64, pre-normalization and a residual
128-wide GELU feed-forward layer. Every tile can attend to every other tile,
including across suits; there are no fixed suji connections or recurrent state.

A zero-initialized residual output refines ordinary/red count logits and all
four shanten-conditioned ukeire slices. The normal runtime compiles tile
attention as one XLA function, alongside the existing hand and river blocks.
Shanten logits use a separate head. Count masks, projection and constraint
supervision apply after refinement. Attention couples marginal predictions;
it does not define a joint distribution over concealed hands or wait sets.

Checkpoints without tile-attention weights require explicit transfer and
fitting before use. Loading remains strict; frozen exports retain their own
architecture.

## Training

The [MMD objective](../training/OBJECTIVE.md) defines action values,
policy anchors and gradient boundaries. The critic predicts current-hand
outcomes projected through the fixed continuation model. There is no separate
state-value head.

Restoration can directly supervise all three belief heads. MMD uses indirect
belief gradients and structural constraints. Hidden-state labels stay outside
inference inputs. The same constrained beliefs feed the policy and Q. Directional training penalties encourage higher
opponent tenpai to increase that opponent's win probability and conditional
exhaustive-draw readiness, and higher wait probability on the candidate tile
to increase that opponent's ron against the actor, with other inputs fixed.
These are soft penalties, not global monotonicity guarantees.

One settlement head handles immediate and later endings. The critic learns
from observed current-hand payments for recorded or rerun actions. Unplayed
actions receive no settlement target; MMD evaluates them with detached critic
forecasts. See the [phase coverage](../training/OBJECTIVE.md).
Automatic aborts without a policy action have no Q slot.

# Constraints and gradients

[Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md) · [Candidate objective](../training/OBJECTIVE.md)

## Shared representation

Forward masks enforce legality. Detached constrained targets also train raw
predictions so the heads and shared encoder learn the constraints.

| Output | Constraint loss |
| --- | --- |
| Categorical heads | Forward KL to constrained targets |
| Yaku and route marginals | Bernoulli KL |
| Critic settlements | Payment, score and deposit constraints |

Shared-head constraint weight is 0.01. Critic constraints join the critic
objective at weight 1.0. Unknown feasible yaku do not become positive labels.
Padded rows do not contribute.

Opponent held-count marginals respect known meld copies, concealed hand sizes
and shared unseen-copy limits. Declared riichi or four fixed melds (hadaka
tanki) fix the opponent's shanten distribution to tenpai. Both require tenpai
in exhaustive-draw settlements; four melds do not imply a riichi deposit.
Both projections teach their raw heads through detached-target KL penalties.
Direct belief supervision uses the projected outputs.

Structural wait probability is tenpai probability times the conditional wait
probability. There is one settlement head, with no separate immediate-ron
branch. Last-discard and abort boundaries restrict event support, preserving
ron priority and declaration timing. Future wins are not capped by present
waits because hands can change before winning.

Directional penalties compare half/double belief-odds probes with all other
inputs fixed. Higher opponent tenpai should increase that opponent's winning
probability and readiness conditional on exhaustive draw. Higher conditional
wait probability on the candidate tile should increase that opponent's ron
against the actor. Triple-ron abort is excluded from winning marginals.
Violating probe pairs train toward a detached equal-probability target;
probe inputs are detached so the critic, not the belief labels, absorbs this
penalty. The terms enter critic constraints once. They encourage directional
consistency but do not guarantee global monotonicity. Known readiness and
no-tile actions naturally have no applicable probe change.

## Policy exceptions

| Case | Treatment |
| --- | --- |
| Uncomputed action slots | Constant padding and hard legality mask |
| No legal win opportunity | Win head masked; not a decline label |
| Legal ron or tsumo | Restoration learns accept/decline; MMD shares one forecast |
| Heuristic policy priors | Restoration only; excluded from MMD |

Padding must not penalize the arbitrary common offset of learned action scores.
Non-winning positions must not teach the model to refuse wins. Neither case
receives a raw-to-masked policy penalty.

## Calls

Call forecasts condition on attempting the action, including preemption by
other claims. Hypothetical accepted-call features describe the candidate;
constraints use facts guaranteed before acceptance. The follow-up discard
remains contingent. Passing also waits for priority resolution, including
pending riichi declarations and last-wall boundaries.

## Data compatibility

Feature layouts, labels and score vocabularies must agree across datasets,
weights and exports. Consumers validate the dataset summary against the current
schema. Regenerate records after a contract change; editing their summary does
not convert them. Frozen exports retain their matching source.

"""Mahjong network components, scoring, export and inference."""

"""Opponent belief heads, constraints and supervision."""

import math

import tensorflow as tf

from model import actions, losses

TENPAI_UKEIRE_WEIGHT = 9.0


def held_count_context(inputs):
    """Known meld copies, unseen physical copies and concealed hand sizes."""
    tile = tf.cast(inputs["meld_tile_ids"][:, 1:], tf.int32)
    red = tf.cast(inputs["meld_tile_red"][:, 1:], tf.bool)
    code = tf.where(red, 34 + tile // 9, tile)
    valid = tf.cast(inputs["meld_tile_valid"][:, 1:], tf.float32)
    lower = tf.reduce_sum(tf.one_hot(code, 37) * valid[..., None], axis=(2, 3))
    unseen = 4 - tf.cast(inputs["known_unavailable_counts"], tf.float32)
    unseen_red = (
        1
        - tf.cast(inputs["candidate_hand_red"][:, 0], tf.float32)
        - tf.cast(inputs["public_visible_red_counts"], tf.float32)
    )
    correction = tf.linalg.matmul(unseen_red, tf.one_hot([4, 13, 22], 34))
    available = tf.concat([unseen - correction, unseen_red], -1)
    size = 13 - 3 * tf.reduce_sum(
        tf.cast(inputs["meld_valid"][:, 1:], tf.float32), axis=-1
    )
    return lower, available, size


@tf.keras.utils.register_keras_serializable(package="nejimakidori")
class HeldCountMask(tf.keras.layers.Layer):
    def call(self, values):
        logits, inputs = values
        lower, available, _ = held_count_context(inputs)
        upper = tf.minimum(4.0, lower + tf.maximum(0.0, available[:, None, :]))
        classes = tf.cast(tf.range(5), tf.float32)
        valid = (classes >= lower[..., None]) & (classes <= upper[..., None])
        return tf.where(valid, logits, -1e4)


def opponent_summaries(outputs):
    shanten_log = tf.nn.log_softmax(outputs["opponent_shanten_logits"], -1)
    improving_log = -tf.nn.softplus(
        -outputs["opponent_ukeire_by_shanten_logits"]
    )
    other_log = -tf.nn.softplus(outputs["opponent_ukeire_by_shanten_logits"])
    return {
        "opponent_ukeire_logits": (
            tf.reduce_logsumexp(shanten_log[..., None] + improving_log, -2)
            - tf.reduce_logsumexp(shanten_log[..., None] + other_log, -2)
        ),
        "opponent_wait_logits": (
            shanten_log[..., 0, None]
            + improving_log[..., 0, :]
            - tf.reduce_logsumexp(
                tf.stack(
                    [
                        shanten_log[..., 0, None] + other_log[..., 0, :],
                        tf.broadcast_to(
                            tf.reduce_logsumexp(shanten_log[..., 1:], -1)[
                                ..., None
                            ],
                            tf.shape(other_log[..., 0, :]),
                        ),
                    ],
                    -1,
                ),
                -1,
            )
        ),
    }


BELIEF_HEADS = (
    "opponent_shanten_logits",
    "opponent_ukeire_by_shanten_logits",
    "opponent_hand_count_logits",
)


class Probabilities(tf.keras.layers.Layer):
    def call(self, logits):
        return {
            name: (
                tf.sigmoid(logits[name])
                if name == BELIEF_HEADS[1]
                else tf.nn.softmax(logits[name], axis=-1)
            )
            for name in BELIEF_HEADS
        }


class TileAttention(tf.keras.layers.Layer):
    """Refine count and wait marginals jointly across all 34 tile types."""

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(name="tile_attention", dtype="float32")
        self.identity = tf.keras.layers.Embedding(34, 8, dtype="float32")
        self.context = tf.keras.layers.Dense(3 * 32, dtype="float32")
        self.tokens = tf.keras.layers.Dense(64, dtype="float32")
        self.attention = [
            tf.keras.layers.MultiHeadAttention(
                num_heads=4, key_dim=16, dtype="float32"
            )
            for _ in range(2)
        ]
        self.attention_norm = [
            tf.keras.layers.LayerNormalization(dtype="float32")
            for _ in range(2)
        ]
        self.feedforward_norm = [
            tf.keras.layers.LayerNormalization(dtype="float32")
            for _ in range(2)
        ]
        self.feedforward = [
            tf.keras.Sequential(
                [
                    tf.keras.layers.Dense(
                        128, activation="gelu", dtype="float32"
                    ),
                    tf.keras.layers.Dense(64, dtype="float32"),
                ]
            )
            for _ in range(2)
        ]
        # New refinements initially preserve the existing belief predictions.
        self.correction = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
            14,
            kernel_initializer="zeros",
            bias_initializer="zeros",
            dtype="float32",
        )

    def call(self, inputs, hidden, counts, waits, shanten):
        lower, available, _ = held_count_context(inputs)
        red_tiles = tf.one_hot([4, 13, 22], 34)
        count_probability = tf.nn.softmax(counts)
        tile_features = tf.concat(
            [
                count_probability[:, :, :34],
                tf.einsum(
                    "bsrc,rt->bstc", count_probability[:, :, 34:], red_tiles
                ),
                tf.transpose(tf.sigmoid(waits), [0, 1, 3, 2]),
                lower[:, :, :34, None] / 4,
                tf.einsum("bsr,rt->bst", lower[:, :, 34:], red_tiles)[
                    ..., None
                ],
                tf.broadcast_to(
                    available[:, None, :34, None] / 4,
                    tf.shape(lower[:, :, :34, None]),
                ),
                tf.broadcast_to(
                    tf.einsum("br,rt->bt", available[:, 34:], red_tiles)[
                        :, None, :, None
                    ],
                    tf.shape(lower[:, :, :34, None]),
                ),
            ],
            axis=-1,
        )
        values = self.tokens(
            tf.concat(
                [
                    tile_features,
                    tf.broadcast_to(
                        self.identity(tf.range(34))[None, None],
                        [tf.shape(counts)[0], 3, 34, 8],
                    ),
                    tf.broadcast_to(
                        tf.reshape(self.context(hidden), [-1, 3, 1, 32]),
                        [tf.shape(counts)[0], 3, 34, 32],
                    ),
                    tf.broadcast_to(
                        tf.nn.softmax(shanten)[:, :, None],
                        [tf.shape(counts)[0], 3, 34, 4],
                    ),
                ],
                axis=-1,
            )
        )
        values = tf.reshape(values, [-1, 34, 64])
        for attention, attention_norm, feedforward, feedforward_norm in zip(
            self.attention,
            self.attention_norm,
            self.feedforward,
            self.feedforward_norm,
        ):
            normalized = attention_norm(values)
            values = values + attention(normalized, normalized)
            values = values + feedforward(feedforward_norm(values))
        correction = tf.reshape(self.correction(values), [-1, 3, 34, 14])
        return (
            counts
            + tf.concat(
                [
                    correction[..., :5],
                    tf.gather(correction[..., 5:10], [4, 13, 22], axis=2),
                ],
                axis=2,
            ),
            waits + tf.transpose(correction[..., 10:], [0, 1, 3, 2]),
        )


class OpponentBeliefs(tf.keras.Model):
    """Supervised opponent heads on the joint model's board encoder."""

    def __init__(self, encoder):
        super().__init__(name="opponent_beliefs", autocast=False)
        self.encoder = encoder
        self.heads = {
            name: tf.keras.layers.Dense(
                math.prod(actions.ACTOR_OUTPUTS[name]),
                dtype="float32",
                name=name.removesuffix("_logits") + "_scores",
            )
            for name in BELIEF_HEADS
        }
        self.tile_attention = TileAttention()
        self.held_count_mask = HeldCountMask(dtype="float32")
        self.count_projection = CountProjection(dtype="float32")

    def call(self, inputs, hidden):
        outputs = {
            name: tf.reshape(
                self.heads[name](hidden),
                [-1, *actions.ACTOR_OUTPUTS[name]],
            )
            for name in BELIEF_HEADS
        }
        outputs[BELIEF_HEADS[2]], outputs[BELIEF_HEADS[1]] = (
            self.tile_attention(
                inputs=inputs,
                hidden=hidden,
                counts=outputs[BELIEF_HEADS[2]],
                waits=outputs[BELIEF_HEADS[1]],
                shanten=outputs[BELIEF_HEADS[0]],
            )
        )
        raw_counts = outputs[BELIEF_HEADS[2]]
        raw_shanten = outputs[BELIEF_HEADS[0]]
        outputs[BELIEF_HEADS[0]] = tf.where(
            (
                (inputs["riichi_state"][:, 1:, None] > 0)
                | (
                    tf.reduce_sum(
                        tf.cast(inputs["meld_valid"][:, 1:] > 0, tf.int32), -1
                    )[..., None]
                    == 4
                )
            )
            & (tf.range(4)[None, None] != 0),
            -1e4,
            raw_shanten,
        )
        outputs[BELIEF_HEADS[2]] = self.held_count_mask(
            [outputs[BELIEF_HEADS[2]], inputs]
        )
        outputs[BELIEF_HEADS[2]] = self.count_projection(
            [outputs[BELIEF_HEADS[2]], inputs]
        )
        outputs["belief_constraint_loss"] = tf.reduce_mean(
            losses.constraint_divergence(raw_counts, outputs[BELIEF_HEADS[2]]),
            axis=(1, 2),
        ) + tf.reduce_mean(
            losses.constraint_divergence(raw_shanten, outputs[BELIEF_HEADS[0]]),
            axis=1,
        )
        return outputs


def count_weights(features):
    """Shared strategic weights for count supervision and projection."""
    base = tf.constant(list(range(34)) + [4, 13, 22])
    winds = tf.cast(features["seat_wind"][:, 1:], tf.int32) + 27
    prevailing = tf.cast(features["prevailing_wind"], tf.int32) + 27
    yakuhai = (
        (base[None, None] >= 31)
        | (base[None, None] == winds[..., None])
        | (base[None, None] == prevailing[:, None, None])
    )
    return (
        1
        + 9
        * tf.gather(
            tf.cast(features["dora_multiplicity"], tf.float32), base, axis=-1
        )[:, None]
        + 9 * tf.cast(tf.range(37) >= 34, tf.float32)
        + 4 * tf.cast(yakuhai, tf.float32)
    )


@tf.keras.utils.register_keras_serializable(package="nejimakidori")
class CountProjection(tf.keras.layers.Layer):
    """Weighted minimum-KL marginal projection using public constraints.

    Input logits must already have HeldCountMask applied. This enforces
    expected concealed sizes and shared physical copy limits, not a joint
    distribution over legal hands. No hidden labels enter the projection.
    """

    def call(self, values):
        logits, features = values
        lower, available, size = held_count_context(features)
        classes = tf.range(5, dtype=tf.float32) - lower[..., None]
        weights = count_weights(features)

        def solve(logits):
            def moments(alpha, beta):
                probability = tf.nn.softmax(
                    logits
                    + classes
                    * (alpha[..., None, None] + beta[:, None, :, None])
                    / weights[..., None],
                    -1,
                )
                mean = tf.reduce_sum(probability * classes, -1)
                curvature = (
                    tf.reduce_sum(
                        probability * tf.square(classes - mean[..., None]), -1
                    )
                    / weights
                )
                return mean, curvature

            @tf.function(jit_compile=True)
            def step(iteration, alpha, beta, error):
                mean, curvature = moments(alpha, beta)
                alpha += tf.clip_by_value(
                    (size - tf.reduce_sum(mean, -1))
                    / tf.maximum(tf.reduce_sum(curvature, -1), 1e-7),
                    -2.0,
                    2.0,
                )
                mean, curvature = moments(alpha, beta)
                beta = tf.minimum(
                    0.0,
                    beta
                    + tf.clip_by_value(
                        (available - tf.reduce_sum(mean, 1))
                        / tf.maximum(tf.reduce_sum(curvature, 1), 1e-7),
                        -2.0,
                        2.0,
                    ),
                )
                mean, _ = moments(alpha, beta)
                error = tf.maximum(
                    tf.reduce_max(tf.abs(tf.reduce_sum(mean, -1) - size)),
                    tf.reduce_max(
                        tf.abs(
                            tf.where(
                                beta < 0,
                                tf.reduce_sum(mean, 1) - available,
                                tf.nn.relu(tf.reduce_sum(mean, 1) - available),
                            )
                        )
                    ),
                )
                return iteration + 1, alpha, beta, error

            _, alpha, beta, error = tf.while_loop(
                lambda iteration, alpha, beta, error: (iteration < 2048)
                & (error > 1e-5),
                step,
                (
                    0,
                    tf.zeros_like(size),
                    tf.zeros_like(available),
                    float("inf"),
                ),
            )
            return (
                (
                    logits
                    + classes
                    * (alpha[..., None, None] + beta[:, None, :, None])
                    / weights[..., None]
                ),
                error,
                beta,
            )

        @tf.custom_gradient
        def projected(logits):
            result, error, beta = tf.function(solve, jit_compile=True)(
                tf.stop_gradient(logits)
            )

            @tf.function(jit_compile=True)
            def gradient(upstream, error_gradient):
                probability = tf.cast(tf.nn.softmax(result), tf.float64)
                counts = tf.cast(classes, tf.float64)
                weight = tf.cast(weights, tf.float64)
                mean = tf.reduce_sum(probability * counts, -1)
                curvature = (
                    tf.reduce_sum(
                        probability * tf.square(counts - mean[..., None]), -1
                    )
                    / weight
                )
                active = tf.cast(beta < 0, tf.float64)
                cross = curvature * active[:, None]
                column_curvature = tf.reduce_sum(cross, 1)
                right = (
                    tf.reduce_sum(tf.cast(upstream, tf.float64) * counts, -1)
                    / weight
                )
                right_column = tf.reduce_sum(right, 1) * active
                scaled = tf.math.divide_no_nan(cross, column_curvature[:, None])
                # Eliminate tile multipliers; only a 3x3 hand system remains.
                # Float64 protects cancellation in the Schur complement.
                schur = tf.linalg.diag(tf.reduce_sum(curvature, -1)) - (
                    scaled @ tf.transpose(cross, [0, 2, 1])
                )
                right_row = tf.reduce_sum(right, -1) - tf.reduce_sum(
                    scaled * right_column[:, None], -1
                )
                eigenvalues, eigenvectors = tf.linalg.eigh(schur)
                # Redundant physical constraints leave zero eigenvalues.
                # Their pseudoinverse leaves projected probabilities unique.
                inverse = tf.where(
                    eigenvalues
                    > tf.reduce_max(eigenvalues, -1, keepdims=True) * 1e-10,
                    tf.math.divide_no_nan(
                        tf.ones_like(eigenvalues), eigenvalues
                    ),
                    0.0,
                )
                row = tf.linalg.matvec(
                    eigenvectors,
                    inverse
                    * tf.linalg.matvec(
                        eigenvectors, right_row, transpose_a=True
                    ),
                )
                column = tf.math.divide_no_nan(
                    right_column - tf.reduce_sum(cross * row[..., None], 1),
                    column_curvature,
                )
                return upstream - tf.cast(
                    probability
                    * (counts - mean[..., None])
                    * (row[..., None, None] + column[:, None, :, None]),
                    upstream.dtype,
                )

            return (result, error), gradient

        result, error = projected(logits)
        tf.debugging.assert_less_equal(
            error, 1e-4, message="Count projection failed to converge"
        )
        return result


def belief_loss_terms(features, labels, outputs, mean=losses.mean_valid):
    """Opponent supervision for joint training."""
    terms = {
        "opponent_shanten_loss": losses.classification(
            labels["opponent_shanten"], outputs[BELIEF_HEADS[0]], mean=mean
        ),
    }
    terms["opponent_ukeire_loss"], metrics = ukeire_loss(
        labels, outputs, mean=mean
    )
    terms["opponent_hand_count_loss"] = losses.classification(
        labels["opponent_hand_counts"],
        outputs[BELIEF_HEADS[2]],
        count_weights(features),
        mean=mean,
    )
    lower, available, size = held_count_context(features)
    concealed = tf.reduce_sum(
        tf.nn.softmax(outputs[BELIEF_HEADS[2]])
        * (tf.range(5, dtype=tf.float32) - lower[..., None]),
        -1,
    )
    metrics.update(
        {
            name: mean(value, tf.ones_like(value))
            for name, value in {
                "count_size_error": tf.reduce_max(
                    tf.abs(tf.reduce_sum(concealed, -1) - size), -1
                ),
                "count_copy_overflow": tf.reduce_max(
                    tf.nn.relu(tf.reduce_sum(concealed, 1) - available), -1
                ),
            }.items()
        }
    )
    return terms, metrics


def ukeire_loss(labels, outputs, mean=losses.mean_valid):
    target = tf.cast(labels["opponent_ukeire"], tf.float32)
    distance = tf.cast(labels["opponent_shanten"], tf.int32)
    logits = tf.gather(
        outputs["opponent_ukeire_by_shanten_logits"],
        tf.maximum(distance, 0),
        axis=2,
        batch_dims=2,
    )
    valid = (target >= 0) & (distance[..., None] >= 0)
    tenpai = valid & (distance[..., None] == 0)
    other = valid & (distance[..., None] > 0)
    losses = tf.nn.sigmoid_cross_entropy_with_logits(
        labels=tf.maximum(target, 0), logits=logits
    )
    tenpai_loss = mean(losses, tenpai)
    other_loss = mean(losses, other)
    loss = tf.math.divide_no_nan(
        TENPAI_UKEIRE_WEIGHT * tenpai_loss + other_loss,
        TENPAI_UKEIRE_WEIGHT * mean(tf.ones_like(target), tenpai)
        + mean(tf.ones_like(target), other),
    )
    probability = tf.math.sigmoid(logits)
    metrics = {
        "tenpai_ukeire_loss": tenpai_loss,
        "other_ukeire_loss": other_loss,
        "tenpai_wait_recall_at_0_5": mean(
            tf.cast(probability >= 0.5, tf.float32), tenpai & (target == 1)
        ),
        "tenpai_wait_precision_at_0_5": mean(
            target, tenpai & (probability >= 0.5)
        ),
        "tenpai_wait_brier": mean(tf.square(probability - target), tenpai),
        "tenpai_wait_positive_brier": mean(
            tf.square(probability - target), tenpai & (target == 1)
        ),
        "tenpai_wait_recall_at_5": mean(
            tf.reduce_sum(
                tf.one_hot(tf.math.top_k(probability, 5).indices, 34), -2
            ),
            tenpai & (target == 1),
        ),
        "joint_wait_brier": mean(
            tf.square(
                tf.math.sigmoid(outputs["opponent_wait_logits"])
                - tf.cast(tenpai & (target == 1), tf.float32)
            ),
            valid,
        ),
        "opponent_ukeire_brier": mean(
            tf.square(
                tf.math.sigmoid(outputs["opponent_ukeire_logits"]) - target
            ),
            valid,
        ),
    }
    return loss, metrics

"""Action-conditioned settlements and policy values."""

import numpy
import tensorflow as tf

from log_dataset import scoring
from model import (
    actions,
    encoder,
    joint_settlement,
    losses,
    outcomes,
    payment_scoring,
)

STATISTICS_CHUNK = 512


def public_inputs(features, selected=None):
    """Guaranteed scoring constraints given an attempted action.

    Scores and the existing pot remain pre-action: settlement deposits account
    for a declaration only after its discard survives ron.
    """
    opened = tf.reduce_any(
        (features["meld_valid"] > 0) & (features["meld_type"] != 4), axis=-1
    )
    public = {
        "opened": opened,
        "deposit_allowed": ~opened
        & (features["riichi_state"] != 2)
        & (features["seat_context"][:, :, 0] >= 0.01),
        "deposit_required": features["riichi_state"] == 1,
        "riichi_required": features["riichi_state"] > 0,
        "tenpai_required": (features["riichi_state"] > 0)
        | (
            tf.reduce_sum(tf.cast(features["meld_valid"] > 0, tf.int32), -1)
            == 4
        ),
        "action_tile": tf.fill(tf.shape(features["dealer_relative_seat"]), 37),
        "ending_draw_kind": tf.zeros_like(features["dealer_relative_seat"]),
        "ending_tenpai": tf.fill(tf.shape(features["riichi_state"]), -1),
        "ending_safe": tf.zeros_like(features["riichi_state"][:, 1:], tf.bool),
        "dealer": features["dealer_relative_seat"],
        "public_fu": tf.cast(features["public_fu"], tf.int32),
        "public_bonus": tf.cast(features["public_bonus"], tf.int32),
        "yakuman_allowed": payment_scoring.support(
            payment_scoring.public_melds(features)
        )[..., -1],
    }
    if selected is None:
        return public
    public = {
        name: tf.gather(value, selected[:, 0]) for name, value in public.items()
    }
    response = tf.gather(features["decision_phase"], selected[:, 0]) == 1
    hands = tf.stack(
        [
            selected[:, 0],
            tf.cast(
                tf.gather_nd(
                    actions.candidate_hand_indices(features), selected
                ),
                tf.int32,
            ),
        ],
        axis=1,
    )
    # Float32 keeps both gathers and slices on device; these small integer
    # counts are exact. TensorFlow's int32 StridedSlice uses host memory.
    melds = tf.gather_nd(
        tf.cast(features["candidate_melds"], tf.float32), hands
    )
    own_opened = tf.reduce_any(
        tf.gather(melds, [0, 1, 2, 4], axis=2) > 0, axis=(1, 2)
    )
    declaration = (selected[:, 1] >= 74) & (selected[:, 1] < 111)
    own = tf.stack(
        [
            tf.range(tf.shape(selected)[0]),
            tf.zeros(tf.shape(selected)[0], tf.int32),
        ],
        axis=1,
    )
    public["opened"] = tf.tensor_scatter_nd_update(
        public["opened"],
        own,
        tf.where(response, public["opened"][:, 0], own_opened),
    )
    for name in ("public_fu", "public_bonus"):
        public[name] = tf.tensor_scatter_nd_update(
            public[name],
            own,
            tf.where(
                response,
                public[name][:, 0],
                tf.cast(
                    tf.gather_nd(
                        tf.cast(features["candidate_" + name], tf.float32),
                        hands,
                    ),
                    tf.int32,
                ),
            ),
        )
    public["yakuman_allowed"] = tf.tensor_scatter_nd_update(
        public["yakuman_allowed"],
        own,
        tf.where(
            response,
            public["yakuman_allowed"][:, 0],
            payment_scoring.support(melds)[..., -1],
        ),
    )
    public["deposit_allowed"] &= ~public["opened"]
    for name in ("deposit_required", "riichi_required"):
        public[name] = tf.tensor_scatter_nd_update(
            public[name], own, public[name][:, 0] | declaration
        )
        # A competing ron can end the hand before a pending declaration
        # is accepted. Hypothetical call features remain in learned context.
        public[name] &= ~(
            response[:, None]
            & (tf.gather(features["riichi_state"], selected[:, 0]) == 1)
        )
    # Only an unconditional own discard can force a draw at this boundary.
    # Response passes still await opponents' claims, including last-tile ron.
    discard = actions.discard_decisions(features, selected) & ~response
    public["tenpai_required"] |= public["riichi_required"]
    public["tenpai_required"] = tf.tensor_scatter_nd_update(
        public["tenpai_required"],
        own,
        public["tenpai_required"][:, 0]
        | (~response & (tf.reduce_sum(melds[:, :, :5], (1, 2)) == 4)),
    )
    public["action_tile"] = tf.where(
        selected[:, 1] < 111,
        selected[:, 1] % 37,
        tf.where(
            (selected[:, 1] >= 112) & (selected[:, 1] < 260),
            (selected[:, 1] - 112) % 37,
            tf.where(selected[:, 1] >= 261, selected[:, 1] - 261, 37),
        ),
    )
    tile = tf.where(selected[:, 1] < 111, selected[:, 1] % 37, 0)
    abort = (
        tf.gather_nd(
            features["discard_abort"],
            tf.stack(
                [selected[:, 0], tf.cast(declaration, tf.int32), tile],
                axis=1,
            ),
        )
        > 0
    )
    public["ending_safe"] = tf.gather_nd(
        tf.transpose(actions.guaranteed_safe_tiles(features), [0, 2, 1]),
        tf.stack(
            [
                selected[:, 0],
                tf.where(tile < 34, tile, 4 + 9 * (tile - 34)),
            ],
            axis=1,
        ),
    )
    public["ending_draw_kind"] = tf.where(
        discard & abort,
        2,
        tf.where(
            discard
            & (tf.gather(features["live_wall_count"], selected[:, 0]) == 0),
            1,
            0,
        ),
    )
    public["ending_tenpai"] = tf.concat(
        [
            tf.cast(
                tf.gather_nd(
                    features["discard_action_all_shanten"],
                    tf.stack([selected[:, 0], tile], axis=1),
                )
                == 1,
                tf.int32,
            )[:, None],
            tf.where(public["tenpai_required"][:, 1:], 1, -1),
        ],
        axis=1,
    )
    return public


class PublicContext(tf.keras.layers.Layer):
    def call(self, values):
        inputs, selected, structural = values
        tiles = tf.cast(structural[:, -1], tf.int32)
        # Code 37 denotes an action without a tile. Red fives retain their
        # identity in the one-hot feature, but share public safety with fives.
        base = tf.where(
            tiles == 37, 0, tf.where(tiles < 34, tiles, 4 + 9 * (tiles - 34))
        )
        tile_indices = tf.stack([selected[:, 0], base], axis=-1)
        has_tile = tf.cast(tiles != 37, tf.float32)[:, None]
        # Eighteen two-sided wait lines: 14, 25, 36, 47, 58, 69 in each suit.
        # Genbutsu at either endpoint rules out that entire ryanmen line.
        lower = tf.constant(
            [9 * suit + rank for suit in range(3) for rank in range(6)]
        )
        live_lines = ~(
            tf.gather(inputs["genbutsu_to_seat"], lower, axis=2) > 0
        ) & ~(tf.gather(inputs["genbutsu_to_seat"], lower + 3, axis=2) > 0)
        remaining = tf.gather(
            tf.reduce_sum(tf.cast(live_lines, tf.float32), axis=2),
            selected[:, 0],
        )
        tile_lines = (
            tf.reduce_sum(
                tf.cast(tf.gather(live_lines, selected[:, 0]), tf.float32)
                * tf.cast(
                    (base[:, None] == lower) | (base[:, None] == lower + 3),
                    tf.float32,
                )[:, None],
                axis=2,
            )
            * has_tile
        )
        return tf.concat(
            [
                tf.one_hot(tiles, 38),
                tf.one_hot(
                    tf.searchsorted(
                        [37, 74, 111, 112, 223, 260, 261],
                        selected[:, 1],
                        side="right",
                    ),
                    8,
                ),
                tf.cast(
                    tf.gather(inputs["riichi_state"], selected[:, 0]),
                    tf.float32,
                )
                / 2,
                tf.cast(
                    tf.gather(inputs["ippatsu_alive"], selected[:, 0]),
                    tf.float32,
                ),
                tf.cast(
                    tf.gather(
                        inputs["opponent_called_tile_count"], selected[:, 0]
                    ),
                    tf.float32,
                )
                / 16,
                tf.cast(
                    tf.gather(inputs["opponent_discard_count"], selected[:, 0]),
                    tf.float32,
                )
                / 24,
                tf.one_hot(
                    tf.cast(
                        tf.gather(
                            inputs["dealer_relative_seat"], selected[:, 0]
                        ),
                        tf.int32,
                    ),
                    4,
                ),
                *[
                    tf.cast(
                        tf.gather_nd(
                            tf.transpose(inputs[name], [0, 2, 1]), tile_indices
                        ),
                        tf.float32,
                    )
                    * has_tile
                    / scale
                    for name, scale in (
                        ("genbutsu_to_seat", 1),
                        ("sotogawa_earliest_turn_to_seat", 6),
                    )
                ],
                tf.cast(
                    tf.gather_nd(inputs["blocker_counts"], tile_indices),
                    tf.float32,
                )
                * has_tile
                / 4,
                *[
                    tf.cast(
                        tf.gather_nd(inputs[name], tile_indices), tf.float32
                    )[:, None]
                    * has_tile
                    / 4
                    for name in (
                        "known_unavailable_counts",
                        "dora_multiplicity",
                    )
                ],
                remaining / 18,
                tile_lines / 2,
                tf.math.divide_no_nan(tile_lines, remaining),
                tf.cast(
                    tf.gather_nd(
                        tf.transpose(
                            inputs["passed_unchanged_to_seat"], [0, 2, 1]
                        ),
                        tile_indices,
                    ),
                    tf.float32,
                )
                * has_tile,
                tf.reshape(
                    tf.cast(
                        tf.gather(inputs["riichi_push_count"], selected[:, 0]),
                        tf.float32,
                    ),
                    (-1, 16),
                )
                / 24,
            ],
            axis=-1,
        )


class HandContext(tf.keras.layers.Layer):

    def call(self, values):
        inputs, selected, structural = values
        hands = tf.stack(
            [
                selected[:, 0],
                tf.cast(
                    tf.gather_nd(
                        actions.candidate_hand_indices(inputs),
                        selected,
                    ),
                    tf.int32,
                ),
            ],
            axis=1,
        )
        melds = tf.gather_nd(
            tf.cast(inputs["candidate_melds"], tf.float32), hands
        )
        red = tf.reduce_sum(
            tf.gather_nd(
                tf.cast(inputs["candidate_hand_red"], tf.float32), hands
            ),
            axis=-1,
        ) + tf.reduce_sum(melds[:, :, 5], axis=-1)
        counts = (
            tf.gather_nd(
                tf.cast(inputs["candidate_hand_counts"], tf.float32), hands
            )
            + 3 * melds[:, :, 1]
            + 4 * tf.reduce_sum(melds[:, :, 2:5], axis=-1)
            + tf.add_n(
                [tf.roll(melds[:, :, 0], shift, axis=1) for shift in range(3)]
            )
        )
        dora = (
            tf.reduce_sum(
                counts
                * tf.cast(
                    tf.gather(inputs["dora_multiplicity"], selected[:, 0]),
                    tf.float32,
                ),
                axis=-1,
            )
            + red
        )
        return tf.concat(
            [
                tf.stack(
                    [
                        dora,
                        red,
                        tf.cast(
                            tf.gather(
                                inputs["live_wall_count"], selected[:, 0]
                            ),
                            tf.float32,
                        )
                        / 70,
                        tf.reduce_sum(
                            4
                            - tf.cast(
                                tf.gather(
                                    inputs["known_unavailable_counts"],
                                    selected[:, 0],
                                ),
                                tf.float32,
                            ),
                            axis=-1,
                        )
                        / 136,
                    ],
                    axis=-1,
                ),
                tf.math.asinh(tf.cast(structural[:, :-1], tf.float32)),
            ],
            axis=-1,
        )


class PlayerContext(tf.keras.layers.Layer):
    """Public player descriptors, without learned opponent-slot predictions."""

    def call(self, values):
        inputs, rivers, selected = values
        players = tf.concat(
            [
                tf.broadcast_to(
                    tf.constant([1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0])[None, :, None],
                    (tf.shape(rivers)[0], 4, 1),
                ),
                tf.concat(
                    [tf.zeros_like(rivers[:, :1]), tf.cast(rivers, tf.float32)],
                    axis=1,
                ),
                tf.cast(inputs["seat_context"], tf.float32),
                # Wind identity is not a player ID. Expose its scoring and
                # tile-availability consequences instead.
                tf.stack(
                    [
                        tf.cast(inputs["seat_wind"] == 0, tf.float32),
                        tf.cast(
                            inputs["seat_wind"]
                            == inputs["prevailing_wind"][:, None],
                            tf.float32,
                        ),
                        *[
                            tf.cast(
                                tf.gather(
                                    inputs[name],
                                    tf.cast(inputs["seat_wind"], tf.int32) + 27,
                                    axis=1,
                                    batch_dims=1,
                                ),
                                tf.float32,
                            )
                            / scale
                            for name, scale in (
                                ("known_unavailable_counts", 4),
                                ("dora_multiplicity", 5),
                            )
                        ],
                    ],
                    axis=-1,
                ),
                *[
                    tf.cast(inputs[name], tf.float32)[..., None] / scale
                    for name, scale in (
                        ("riichi_state", 2),
                        ("ippatsu_alive", 1),
                        ("opponent_called_tile_count", 16),
                        ("opponent_discard_count", 24),
                    )
                ],
                *[
                    tf.math.asinh(tf.cast(inputs[name], tf.float32))
                    for name in (
                        "last_tedashi_tile",
